At Owens & Minor, we are a critical part of the healthcare process. As a Fortune 500 company with 50+ facilities across the US and 18,000 teammates in over 90 countries, we provide integrated technologies, products and services across the full continuum of care. Customers—and their patients—are at the heart of what we do.

Our mission is to empower our customers to advance healthcare, and our success starts with our teammates.

Owens & Minor Teammate Benefits Include

Medical, dental, and vision insurance, available on first working day401(k), eligibility after 30 days of employmentEmployee stock purchase planTuition reimbursementDevelopment opportunities to grow your career with a global company

Senior Global Director, Talent Acquisition

Position Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and versatile Talent Acquisition leader with a passion for connecting talent solutions to business opportunities to maximize results. As the Senior Director, Global Talent Acquisition (TA), you will have an opportunity to transform the TA organization at Owens & Minor, significantly enhancing our ability to drive company growth and make each day better for the patients, providers, and communities we serve. You will be a passionate and energetic talent steward; leading efforts to build upon Owens & Minor’s existing recruitment foundation - first in the US and then globally as we evolve.

You will be counted on to solve problems and lead through change while proactively anticipating and developing workforce strategies for today and tomorrow. Building strong, credible relationships with leaders across the company and investing in the growth of your team are two critical success factors for this role. This role requires someone who operates with a continuous improvement mindset with a focus on innovation to reimagine the possibilities. You will embody the Owens & Minor IDEAL Values (Integrity, Development, Excellence, Accountability, Listening) and approach each day as an opportunity to realize our purpose: Life Takes Care.

You will report to the VP, Global Talent, Learning & Inclusion and be an active member of the Talent leadership team. This role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US.

How You Will Impact

Develop and implement the strategy and operating model for global talent acquisition to position TA as a competitive advantage for Owens & Minor. Identify and monitor key talent attraction metrics to ensure a strong hiring manager and candidate experience and delivery against expected quality & time to fill expectations.Partner with leaders to align workforce strategies to business requirements through a consultative partnership across the organization.Manage and develop a global team of talent acquisition professionals, elevating strategic and sustainable executional capability by establishing and driving consistency within the servicing model, KPI’s, coaching and mentoring.Provide consult to business and HR stakeholders on talent acquisition related topics, including marketplace trends, talent availability, emerging staffing trends and sourcing and selection strategies while also ensuring legal compliance and resolution of any recruitment related issues.Ensure that the recruiting function is of the highest-quality, motivated and well-aligned with the vision and goals of the organization, not just for current state, but heavily focused on evaluation and enhancements for future needs.Maximize operational efficiency and customer experience through technology – ensure the processes and output align with expected outcomes.Build a recruitment marketing strategy that positions Owens & Minor as an employer of choice in the markets we serve.Partner with key executives to develop talent and pipeline strategies, and to fill critical executive roles as needed.

Experiences And Skills For Success

10+ years of progressive Human Resources Leadership experience, to include at least 2 years of global leadership and problem solving.Bachelor’s degree in human resources or similar discipline.Deep passion for forward-thinking talent acquisition strategies with the ability to roll up sleeves to help execute new ideas across the company's global locations.Demonstrated results in identifying and implementing impactful, enterprise-wide, efficient improvements related to innovative recruitment strategies, operating models, hiring capabilities, process and practice improvements, and talent pools.Experience developing and motivating a global recruiting team, as well as leading through organizational change with proven change management leadership capabilities.Experience developing and implementing strategies encompassing employment branding, innovative sourcing, and diverse pipelining.Owner mentality – successfully reaching across boundaries to solve problems, identify opportunities and drive results.Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution to achieve desired outcomes.Exceptional executive presence; focused on consultative business partnering, collaboration and building trusting partnerships for self and others.

If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply. This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis.
